column3: A wide empty living room background scene for an animation, NO characters, NO people. Flat clean comic illustration with clean ink outlines, soft cel shading, calm palette of pale teal walls (#DDEFED), soft grey-teal floor, a simple sofa, a window with daylight, a small plant, a wall clock. Lots of empty floor space in the middle for a character. Ignore the character reference and the white background rule: this is a background only.

Wide scene: H lying in bed in the morning under a pale teal blanket, reaching for a smartphone on the bedside table with one arm, face wincing in pain, a soft red glow on his chest muscles (soreness), small pain lines. Bedroom in a calm palette of pale teal and soft grey, morning light from a window. Ignore the white background rule: draw the full bedroom scene.
Full-body pure side view of H collapsed flat on the floor face-down right after failing a push-up, arms spread out, exhausted, sweat drops flying, comic dizzy lines above his head, funny.
